_comment: The Pip (lqe, LANA.cpp) build the client packages at <resources>/pip (electron-pip-supervisor.js), built by scripts/build-pip.sh on a matching computer with LANA.cpp's distribution contract. The v3.0.0 tag was MOVED on 2026-11-12T14:17:11Z from bb191effb26c to this commit (D-41 Metal defaults: adaptive prefill on and a 512-row busy chunk, prefill about 538 to 1750 tok/s; --attn-window refused at start on a GPU cache). bb191effb26c had added --gpu-inexact. The tag name alone cannot tell a build before a move from one after, so scripts/build-pip.sh refuses a checkout whose v3.0.0 resolves to any other commit (fetch with git fetch --tags --force). Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's sha256.
